description: This file defines a helper class 'Sample' providing utility methods for sample scripts in the PhpSpreadsheet library. The class includes methods for environment detection, file handling, logging, chart rendering, and sample management, and it references various external PhpSpreadsheet components.

classes.name: Sample
classes.description: A helper class providing utility methods for managing sample scripts, file output, environment detection, and logging within PhpSpreadsheet sample code.

methods.name: isCli
methods.description: Determines if the script is running in CLI mode by checking PHP SAPI.

methods.name: getScriptFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename of the currently executing script.

methods.name: isIndex
methods.description: Checks if the current script is 'index' based on its filename.

methods.name: getPageTitle
methods.description: Provides the page title depending on whether it's the index page.

methods.name: getPageHeading
methods.description: Returns an HTML heading or empty string based on script context.

methods.name: getSamples
methods.description: Recursively scans the 'samples' directory for PHP sample files, organizing them by category.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes a Spreadsheet to files in specified formats, optionally including charts, with progress logging.

methods.name: getTemporaryFolder
methods.description: Returns the system temporary directory path, ensuring the 'phpspreadsheet' subdirectory exists.

methods.name: getFilename
methods.description: Generates a filename with a specified extension in the temporary folder.

methods.name: getTemporaryFilename
methods.description: Creates a unique temporary filename with a given extension.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Outputs a log message, formatted for CLI or web.

methods.name: renderChart
methods.description: Renders a chart to a PNG file and outputs it in HTML if not in CLI.

methods.name: titles
methods.description: Logs the title and description of a sample function.

methods.name: displayGrid
methods.description: Displays a 2D array in a textual grid format.

methods.name: logCalculationResult
methods.description: Logs the result of a formula calculation in a worksheet.

methods.name: logWrite
methods.description: Logs details of a write operation.

methods.name: logRead
methods.description: Logs details of a read operation.
